::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 7th 1880  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection: C0171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Miss Gatty](people/person_469.qmd)

I have read [Miss Caillard](people/person_250.qmd)’s first chapter and I cannot help thinking her work promises to be what you would like for Aunt Judy.[^1]

I think she would be willing to wait if you have not room to begin immediately

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Horatia Katherine Frances Gatty (b. 1846), younger sister of Juliana Ewing, was editor of *Aunt Judy's Magazine*.  Emma Marie Caillard (1852-1927) is probably referred to.
